scene: a classroom display board on a wall, faded orange sugar paper gone pink in a rectangle where the sun hits, a double border of corrugated card, forty old staples still in it, one torn corner curling away, a strip of masking tape holding nothing

a hospital car park at first light in fog, empty white-lined bays, a lowered barrier arm with a chevron stripe, three lamp posts fading into grey, wet tarmac holding the light, a low brick wall along the far edge

a printed shift rota on a kitchen table, folded in three and pressed flat again so the creases stand up, a grid of ruled boxes with short pencil marks in some of them, one corner turned down, the table a scratched pale laminate
a round dark-crusted loaf half out of a brown paper bag on a worktop, the bag torn open down one side, flour dust on the counter, a bread knife lying beside it, morning light from the left
a wide shallow bowl of dark brown soup on a wooden table, steam gone, a spoon resting in it at an angle, an empty second bowl stacked behind, two salt grains and a ring of spilled liquid on the wood

an open shallow drawer full of felt-tip markers lying loose with their lids off, colours dulled and dried, a few lids alone at one end, a small handwritten note on lined paper on top of the pile with one word on it underlined twice

an open sketchbook on a floor, a pencil drawing of a cupboard door with a rounded handle, hatching down one side, a rubbed-out first attempt still faintly visible, the good pen lying across the gutter of the book
flat grey canal water under low cloud, a black iron mooring ring set in the stone edge, a coil of wet rope, the far bank a line of brick and one bare tree, no wind and no reflection to speak of
two paper cups on a low brick wall, one crushed flat and one still full with a lid on, a car park barrier arm out of focus behind, early sun raking across the brick

wooden crates on a market stall, apples in two of them and one squash on its own, three hand-lettered price cards on wire stalks, a set of brass scales at the back, canvas shadow falling across the front row
